personas.name: routine-polyp-surveillance-colonoscopy-low-risk-complete
personas.description: Well-formed routine surveillance referral: colonoscopy is first-line for polyp-surveillance, the FIT recorded for completeness is negative (4 ug Hb/g, below the NICE DG56 threshold of 10, so it does not itself trigger the suspected-cancer pathway), no anticoagulation or fitness concerns, every completeness field present — expect usually-appropriate + low risk + routine + accept.

request.clinicalQuestion: Two tubular adenomas removed at colonoscopy 3 years ago — due routine surveillance colonoscopy per the post-polypectomy interval.
request.relevantHistory: No new symptoms. No family history of colorectal cancer.

triage.notes: Routine surveillance slot; patient already sent prep instructions.

expected.twoWeekWaitRationale: Does not meet NICE NG12 / DG56 two-week-wait suspected-cancer criteria.

firedRules.description: Requested colonoscopy is the recommended examination for "polyp-surveillance".
No suspected-cancer escalation; urgency follows the requested tier (routine).
No anticoagulant, prep-fitness, renal, or ASA risk factors identified.

personas.name: two-week-wait-positive-fit-colonoscopy-anticoagulant-high-risk-redirect
personas.description: Symptomatic patient with a strongly positive FIT test: colonoscopy is first-line and the FIT result alone (45 ug Hb/g, well above the NICE DG56 threshold of 10) meets two-week-wait suspected-cancer eligibility regardless of requested urgency, but the patient is on rivaroxaban — anticoagulation is a high bleeding risk for this high-risk procedure and the recommendation is to redirect for periprocedural anticoagulant planning before booking, even though the request is otherwise appropriate and complete — expect usually-appropriate + high risk + two-week-wait + redirect.

request.clinicalQuestion: Six weeks of altered bowel habit and abdominal discomfort, symptomatic FIT 45 ug Hb/g — colonoscopy requested.
request.relevantHistory: Atrial fibrillation on rivaroxaban. No previous colonoscopy.

triage.notes: Anticoagulation clinic to advise on periprocedural rivaroxaban omission before booking.

expected.twoWeekWaitRationale: Positive FIT (45 ug Hb/g >= 10, NICE DG56) — suspected-cancer pathway.
expected.anticoagulantAction: On Rivaroxaban: plan periprocedural interruption per BSG / ESGE (omit DOAC on the morning of the procedure; bridge warfarin per INR / thrombotic risk).

firedRules.description: Requested colonoscopy is the recommended examination for "change-in-bowel-habit".
Positive FIT (45 ug Hb/g >= 10, NICE DG56) — suspected-cancer pathway.
Anticoagulant therapy — high bleeding risk for a high-risk lower-GI procedure (BSG / ESGE).

flags.description: Positive FIT (45 ug Hb/g >= 10, NICE DG56) — suspected-cancer pathway.
flags.suggestedAction: Book on the suspected-cancer two-week-wait pathway; ensure the patient is informed and tracked.
Plan periprocedural anticoagulant management per BSG / ESGE before booking a high-risk lower-GI procedure.

personas.name: emergency-active-rectal-bleeding-incomplete
personas.description: Active rectal bleeding phoned through from the emergency department: colonoscopy is first-line for rectal-bleeding, and the combination of the emergency setting with active bleeding auto-escalates triage to emergency regardless of the requested urgency; the patient is on no anticoagulation and otherwise low risk, but several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-appropriate + low risk + emergency + accept, completeness below 100.

request.relevantHistory: Ongoing fresh rectal bleeding for 4 hours, no clot passage, haemodynamically stable so far.

triage.notes: Phoned through from ED resus; surgical team also aware, two units cross-matched as a precaution.

expected.twoWeekWaitRationale: Does not meet NICE NG12 / DG56 two-week-wait suspected-cancer criteria.

firedRules.description: Requested colonoscopy is the recommended examination for "rectal-bleeding".
Emergency setting with active rectal bleeding — auto-escalated to emergency.
No anticoagulant, prep-fitness, renal, or ASA risk factors identified.

flags.description: No FIT result recorded for a symptomatic lower-GI referral.
flags.suggestedAction: Request a quantitative FIT to guide the colorectal-cancer pathway (NICE DG56).
Query the referrer for the specific question the procedure should answer.
